preconditions.description: The number of computers n must be between 1 and 1500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= (n * (n - 1)) // 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: All values a_{i,j} must be non-negative and within the specified bounds.
The diagonal elements a_{i,i} must be equal to 0.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] > 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
preconditions.description: All off-diagonal elements a_{i,j} for i < j must be greater than 0.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
preconditions.description: The matrix must be symmetric, meaning a_{i,j} must equal a_{j,i}.

preconditions.expression: len(set(a[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))) == (n * (n - 1)) // 2
preconditions.description: All off-diagonal elements a_{i,j} for i < j must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
All output integers must be non-negative.
All output integers must be less than 998244353.
